selected_evidence.requirement: Containerized web app runs as unprivileged user appsvc on port 8080
selected_evidence.summary: appsvc created as unprivileged uid 1000; nginx:alpine container started by appsvc via rootless podman with -p 8080:80; curl to $NODE_IP:8080 returns HTTP 200

selected_evidence.requirement: Service starts at boot while appsvc has no active login session
selected_evidence.summary: Linger enabled for appsvc giving a persistent systemd --user instance independent of login sessions; systemd --user unit container-webapp.service generated, enabled, and confirmed active while loginctl showed 'No sessions'; unit set enabled prior to restart
Pre-restart boot_id 67f3a44b-85c6-40fe-8529-fcb6e8ac337a captured; container-webapp.service confirmed enabled; podman ps showed webapp container running

selected_evidence.requirement: Node restart executed safely, one at a time, acknowledgement returned before disconnect
selected_evidence.summary: 'sudo systemctl reboot' backgrounded so acknowledgement returned before node1 disconnected; subsequent probe timed out confirming the node went down

selected_evidence.requirement: Proof of changed boot identity after restart
selected_evidence.summary: Post-restart boot_id 9a3aedf3-8591-4cb3-ad68-4d963c5c7f49 differs from pre-restart 67f3a44b-85c6-40fe-8529-fcb6e8ac337a, and uptime -s shows a new boot timestamp, proving an actual restart occurred

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required service, data, and no-login-session condition
selected_evidence.summary: After restart: loginctl shows no sessions for appsvc (linger state), systemctl --user is-active reports 'active' for container-webapp.service, podman ps shows a freshly started webapp container, and curl to $NODE_IP:8080 returns HTTP 200
